INSERT INTO "task_master_project_a" (
    "rowId", "parentId", "rowNumber", "Hierarchy", "Critical Milestones",
    "Dashboard Status", "Dashboard Data", "Task Name", "Start", "Finish",
    "Duration", "Percentage Complete", "Predecessors", "Assigned To",
    "Assigned to (% Allocation)", "TF_M1", "FF_M1", "Float", "People Hours",
    "# Resources", "Comments", "Task id"
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json._metadata.rowId }}, 
    {{ $json._metadata.parentId || 'NULL' }}, 
    {{ $json._metadata.rowNumber }},
    {{ $json["Hierarchy"] ? "'" + $json["Hierarchy"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    {{ $json["Critical Milestones"] === "Star" || $json["Critical Milestones"] === true ? "true" : "false" }},
    {{ $json["Dashboard Status"] && $json["Dashboard Status"] !== "null" ? "'" + $json["Dashboard Status"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    {{ $json["Dashboard Data"] && $json["Dashboard Data"] !== "null" ? "'" + $json["Dashboard Data"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    '{{ $json["Task Name"].replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $json["Start"] ? "'" + $json["Start"] + "'::date" : "NULL" }},
    {{ $json["Finish"] ? "'" + $json["Finish"] + "'::date" : "NULL" }},
    {{ $json["Duration"] ? "'" + $json["Duration"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    {{ parseFloat($json["Percentage Complete"]) || 0 }},
    {{ $json["Predecessors"] && $json["Predecessors"] !== "null" ? "'" + $json["Predecessors"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    {{ $json["Assigned To"] && $json["Assigned To"] !== "null" ? "'" + $json["Assigned To"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    {{ parseInt($json["Assigned to (% Allocation)"]) || 0 }},
    {{ parseFloat($json["TF_M1"]) || 0 }},
    {{ parseFloat($json["FF_M1"]) || 0 }},
    {{ parseFloat($json["Float"]) || 0 }},
    {{ parseFloat($json["People Hours"]) || 0 }},
    {{ parseInt($json["# Resources"]) || 0 }},
    {{ $json["Comments"] && $json["Comments"] !== "null" ? "'" + $json["Comments"] + "'" : "NULL" }},
    '{{ $json["Task id"] }}'
)
ON CONFLICT ("rowId") 
DO UPDATE SET
    "rowNumber" = EXCLUDED."rowNumber",
    "Dashboard Status" = EXCLUDED."Dashboard Status",
    "Percentage Complete" = EXCLUDED."Percentage Complete",
    "Finish" = EXCLUDED."Finish",
    "People Hours" = EXCLUDED."People Hours",
    "last_sync" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
